description: For a listing that books appointments on Nexez. With only a slug: the services that book there, each with its length, price, ways to meet, rules, and whether an assistant can book it. With a slug and a service: the open times from the seller's rules (ISO instants, with the seller's time zone), the details every booking needs, and the seller's own questions, each marked assistantMayAnswer true (fill it in from what the buyer already said) or false (ask the buyer directly). Read-only.

service.description: Service id from a previous nexez_booking_options call, for example buyer-consultation. Omit to list the services.

slug.description: Exact published listing slug returned by discovery, not a full URL.

name: nexez_booking_options
title: See Nexez booking options
